basic_details.job_title: ARI Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Nanobioscience (Virology Laboratory) of MACS - Agharkar Research Institute (ARI), Pune, an autonomous institute under the Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India, has invited applications for one temporary Junior Research Fellow post in the DBT, New Delhi project SP-365. The stipend is Rs.37,000 per month plus HRA (as applicable). The essential qualification is First Class in M.Sc. (any field of Life Science) plus a qualifying test. Applications are online at http://arijob.ourlib.in from 18 November 2026 to 2 December 2026, followed by an online interview.

important_dates.interview_date: To be displayed on the Institute website

age_limit.details: The age limit is 28 years; up to 31 years in case of JRF candidates (28+3 years for activation as per JRF guidelines), as on closing date of advt. Relaxation will be applicable for the OBC, SC, ST etc. categories according to Govt of India regulations.

qualification.details: First Class in M.Sc. (any field of Life Science). Qualified in any one of the following tests: CSIR/UGC/ICMR including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) OR GATE. National Level examination DST, DBT, MoE, ICMR, IIT etc.

how_to_apply: Open the online application link http://arijob.ourlib.in and apply on or before 02.12.2026.
Attach self-attested scanned certificates as mentioned in the essential qualification.
Attach a recent passport size photograph.
Attach the caste certificate issued by the competent authority (for reserved category).

Pay the Rs.100 fee online through https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/ if it applies to you. The notice gives the path: Educational Institutions → Categogy → Agharkar Research Institute-MACS → Payment Category → Application Fee, then enter the necessary fields.
Attach the receipt of the online fee payment and write the online receipt number in the application form.
The fee is non-refundable. The Institute is not responsible for incomplete, pending or failed fee transactions, and candidates may contact the concerned bank about them.
important_instructions: The prescribed essential qualifications are minimum; possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Fee exemption applies to SC/ST/Divyang/Women candidates. Both applications and the fee receipt are to reach the portal on or before 02.12.2026, as the notice states.

content_sections.heading: ARI Junior Research Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: MACS - Agharkar Research Institute (An Autonomous Institute under Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India)
"Demytifying the impact of virus infection on the blood coagulation system and exploring the possibility of drug repurposing to treat viral diseases" (SP-365)
Project period up to 25.09.2027; contractual position
28 years; up to 31 years in case of JRF candidates (28+3 years), as on closing date of advt.
Rs.100 (non-refundable); not payable by SC/ST/Divyang/Women candidates

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: First Class in M.Sc. (any field of Life Science). Qualified in any one of the following tests: CSIR/UGC/ICMR including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) OR GATE. National Level examination DST, DBT, MoE, ICMR, IIT etc. Experience in animal handling skills. Experience in virology techniques. Experience in cell biology techniques - immunofluorescence techniques. Experience in molecular biology techniques - RNA extraction, qPCR. For deserving and exceptionally qualified candidates, desirable qualifications may be relaxed at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Equivalence of qualifications to the essential and desirable ones is at the discretion of the committee constituted for scrutinising the applications. The age limit is 28 years; up to 31 years in case of JRF candidates (28+3 years for activation as per JRF guidelines), as on closing date of advt. Relaxation will be applicable for the OBC, SC, ST etc. categories according to Govt of India regulations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly stipend for the ARI Junior Research Fellow post is Rs.37,000/- + HRA (as applicable). The project period runs up to 25.09.2027. The position is purely on contractual basis, and the selected candidate may be assigned to another project based on Institutional requirement. Selected candidates have no right for appointment against any ARI or funding agency's post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ARI Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Open the online application link http://arijob.ourlib.in and apply on or before 02.12.2026. Attach self-attested scanned certificates as mentioned in the essential qualification. Attach a recent passport size photograph. Attach the caste certificate issued by the competent authority (for reserved category). Pay the Rs.100 fee online through https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/ if it applies to you. The notice gives the path: Educational Institutions → Categogy → Agharkar Research Institute-MACS → Payment Category → Application Fee, then enter the necessary fields. Attach the receipt of the online fee payment and write the online receipt number in the application form. The fee is non-refundable. The Institute is not responsible for incomplete, pending or failed fee transactions, and candidates may contact the concerned bank about them.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the ARI Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 temporary Junior Research Fellow post under DBT, New Delhi project SP-365 in the Nanobioscience (Virology Laboratory) of ARI, Pune.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ARI JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 02.12.2026. Applications opened on 18.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ARI Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: First Class in M.Sc. (any field of Life Science), plus qualification in any one of CSIR/UGC/ICMR including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) OR GATE, or a national level examination of DST, DBT, MoE, ICMR, IIT etc.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ARI JRF post?
faq.answer: The limit is 28 years, or up to 31 years for JRF candidates (28+3 years), as on closing date of advt. OBC, SC, ST etc. get relaxation according to Govt of India regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for the ARI Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs.37,000/- + HRA (as applicable).

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs.37,000 stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states the stipend as Rs.37,000/- + HRA (as applicable), so HRA is mentioned in addition to the stipend where applicable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the ARI JRF post?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is Rs.100, except for SC/ST/Divyang/Women candidates. It is paid online through https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the ARI Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Apply online at http://arijob.ourlib.in on or before 02.12.2026, attaching self-attested scanned certificates, a recent passport size photograph, the caste certificate for reserved category and the fee receipt if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected for the ARI JRF post?
faq.answer: Selection is through an online interview, with possible shortlisting if many applications are received. The shortlist and interview day, date and time will be displayed on the Institute website.

faq.question: Q10. Is the ARI Junior Research Fellow post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a temporary, purely contractual position linked to the project, which runs up to 25.09.2027. The candidate may be assigned to another project as per Institutional requirement.
